<template>
  <el-dialog v-model="visible" title="删除网络" width="30%" @close="closeDialog">
    <el-form :model="form">
      <el-form-item label="选择网络" required>
        <el-select v-model="form.networkName" placeholder="请选择要删除的网络" style="width: 100%">
          <el-option
              v-for="name in networkNames"
              :key="name"
              :label="name"
              :value="name"
          />
        </el-select>
      </el-form-item>
    </el-form>
    <template #footer>
      <el-button @click="closeDialog">取消</el-button>
      <el-button type="danger" @click="submitDelete">删除</el-button>
    </template>
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'

const visible = ref(false)
const form = ref({ networkName: '' })
const networkNames = ref([])

const fetchNetworkNames = async () => {
  try {
    const res = await axios.get('http://localhost:8081/network/list')
    networkNames.value = Object.keys(res.data)
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error('获取网络列表失败')
  }
}

const openDialog = () => {
  form.value.networkName = ''
  visible.value = true
  fetchNetworkNames()
}

const closeDialog = () => {
  visible.value = false
  form.value.networkName = ''
}

const submitDelete = async () => {
  if (!form.value.networkName) {
    ElMessage.warning('请选择网络名称')
    return
  }

  try {
    await axios.delete(`http://localhost:8081/network/delete/${form.value.networkName}`)
    ElMessage.success('删除成功')
    // 删除成功后刷新网络列表
    await fetchNetworkNames()
    form.value.networkName = ''
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error('删除失败')
  }
}

// 暴露给父组件打开弹窗
defineExpose({
  openDialog
})
</script>
